title: Flywheel launch checklist and release synopsis (Jun 2026) - WIP
content:
Overview:
This doc is the working checklist, calendar, and release-notes draft for the "flywheel" deployment (small runtime perf and KV cache opt changes). Goal: staged rollout with observability gates and a quick rollback path if tail latency or error rate regressions appear. Target go-window: 2026-06-17 09:00 PT (72h window).

Context / riser:
- Changes: continuous-batching tweak (smaller max-batch), KV prefix caching reindex, kernel selection tweak for MQA layers.
- Risk: possible 95th/99th latency uplift under p50->p99 traffic spikes, small chance of increased memory pressure on 8xA100 nodes.
- Owners: Marisol (release owner), Ethan (runtime lead), Priya (observability), Marco (rollout ops).

Pre-launch checklist (72->0 hours):
- [ ] Merge final GH PR and tag binary (runtime v1.12.0-flywheel). GH PR: runtime/pull/872. (Ethan)
- [ ] Build and stage images to registry (staging + canary clusters). (release-engineering CI)
- [ ] Deploy to staging and run smoke harness (10k tokens/session) — pass SLOs for 1h. (Marco)
- [ ] Canary canary: route 2% traffic to canary for 30m, check p50/p95/p99, error rate, memory RSS. (Priya)
- [ ] Escalation plan reviewed with SRE on-call (pager contact list verified). (Marisol)
- [ ] Preflight ticket update and stakeholder ping (GTM, Solutions). (Marisol)

Rollout calendar (high level):
- T-72h: final branch cut, tag, notify on #release-flywheel, update ENG-4821.
- T-48h: staging smoke complete, initial perf runs.
- T-24h: docs + release notes first pass, QA signoff.
- T-2h: deploy to canary (2%), begin telemetry watch.
- T+1h: if gates pass, bump to 10% for 1h.
- T+3h: if gates pass, 50% for 2h.
- T+6h: 100% rollout and monitor for 24-48h.

Gates and telemetry (what to watch):
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 token latency (gen) across models: rollback if p99 increases >+20% vs baseline or absolute p99 > 700ms for non-lr models.
- Errors: 5xx/timeout rate >+0.5% absolute from baseline -> pause.
- Memory: node RSS increase >+15% sustained for 10m -> pause.
- Throughput: tokens/sec drop >10% -> investigate before continuing.
- User-visible signals: key customer requests sampled (CS list), check quality regressions via eval prompt-set (quick-run).

Canary and mitigation actions (quick play):
- Pause rollout: change route policy to previous model via runtime flag, revert traffic allocation in routing service. (Marco)
- Rollback: roll runtime binary to tag v1.11.9 with immediate routing fallback. (Ethan + Marco)
- Hotfix: if small config fix suspected (batch size), push config change to canary patch without full rollback. (Ethan)
- Emergency scale: request extra nodes from Dedicated pool or spin up transient capacity (SRE play). (SRE on-call)

Quick rollback commands (ops cheat):
- routectl set-weight --service=inference --variant=stable --weight=100
- kubectl -n inference set image deployment/runtime runtime=registry.redwood/v1.11.9
- kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime -n inference --watch

Communication plan:
- Preflight announcement: #release-flywheel in Slack + email to stakeholders (GTM, Solutions, SRE). (Marisol)
- Live updates cadence: every 30 minutes during canary ops to #release-flywheel, and immediate postmortem message if gating fails. (Marco)
- Post-release summary: 24h update + 72h retrospective doc. (Marisol)

Draft release notes (first-pass):
- Headline: runtime v1.12.0-flywheel — improved batching and KV caching for lower average token cost and better throughput on mixed-length workloads.
- What's new:
  • Continuous-batching tuning reduces small-request tail latency for short-context interactive flows.
  • KV prefix caching reindex reduces repeated prefix compute for multi-turn chat.
  • Kernel selection fallback improved for MQA variants on Ampere-class GPUs.
- User impact: mostly internal runtime behavior change; external API unchanged. Expected lower per-token cost for high-concurrency chat apps; in rare cases adaptive batching may increase p99 for extreme spikes (see known issues).
- Known issues (pre-release):
  1) Under synthetic spike tests, some 8xA100 instances showed transient memory pressure causing worker restarts. Mitigation: autoscaler will add nodes; ongoing kernel memory cap PR in ENG-4900.
  2) Small set of eval prompts show +5-10% latency on p99 for long-context MQA models — monitoring in progress.
- Migration/Config notes for Dedicated customers: no required action; recommended: ensure autoscaler headroom >= 10% during rollout window if possible.
- Rollback instructions: included in ops cheat above.

Post-deploy checks (first 24h):
- Confirm no increase in customer-facing errors in sentry and custom traces. (Priya)
- Run regression prompt-set (200 prompts) and check quality / token delta. (Ethan)
- Verify cost-per-token trends in Console for the route. (Finance contact: Lydia Park)
- Schedule 72h retro: what went well, what failed, follow-ups (owner list).

Open questions / TODOs:
- [ ] Confirm Dedicated capacity scaling contract for transient bump (Finance/Sales signoff). (Marisol)
- [ ] Finalize kernel memory cap PR schedule (ENG-4900). (Ethan)
- [ ] Add short-circuit rollback play for private deployments (networking considerations). (Marco)

Notes to self / informal:
- If gates fail on p99 but errors unchanged, suspects batching seeds causing stragglers — try immediate batch-size cap before full rollback.
- Keep feature flags handy in case we want to enable partial behavior only on chat route.

Attachments / links (working):
- Perf run results (staging): drive:/shared/perf/flywheel/staging-run-2026-06-11.csv
- Runbook draft (this doc will be condensed into the 72h runbook on successful validation).
